title: Preview CSP did not explicitly restrict form submission destinations

steps: Open /preview/?resource=button in the Sites Worker browser build.
Insert a POST form targeting https://collector.invalid/collect with employeeName=Alice Example.
Call requestSubmit and inspect both the response CSP and intercepted requests.
reproduction.beforeFix: The preview CSP used default-src 'none' but omitted form-action. The attempted form emitted no external request because the existing opaque sandbox CSP has sandbox allow-scripts without allow-forms; the missing form-action directive left the policy implicit and fragile.
reproduction.browserEvidence: The red Playwright run failed because the CSP header lacked form-action 'none'. Its request observer recorded zero external submissions, confirming that the current sandbox independently blocked the attempt.

rootCause: The preview policy relied on sandboxing for form isolation and assumed default-src also covered form submissions.
remediation: Set form-action 'none' for isolated Sites previews, form-action 'self' for the Sites app shell, and form-action 'none' for the standalone preview host policy. Keep the sandbox control as an independent boundary.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/e2e/sites-preview.playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/sites-preview-csp.spec.ts -g "preview CSP blocks forms"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: form-action 'none' was absent; the sandbox prevented a network request
validation.greenAfterFix: the same test passed for desktop Chromium and the mobile Chromium profile
assertions: POST submission containing a sample field value produced no request to collector.invalid

runtimeBoundary: The external URL was intercepted in Playwright. No request left the local browser. Before the fix, the existing sandbox blocked the submission even though the explicit form-action rule was missing.
